purpose: Own Physics Portfolio status, Mastery Goal grades, PowerSchool MG exports, intervention routing, evidence interpretation, practice routing, and recurring report fidelity while exact Unit Assessment Plans own learning content.

mastered_default_rule.normal_requirement: At least two independent convincing demonstrations, normally from different opportunities.
mastered_default_rule.later_weak_event: One later weak event does not automatically remove established mastery.
mastered_default_rule.accommodations: Approved accommodations do not lower the evidence status of a valid demonstration.

mastery_goal_rule.general_rule: A Mastery Goal is demonstrated when at least half of its exact I Cans, rounded up, are Mastered or Transfer.

mastery_goal_grade_model.not_assessed_rule: No usable evidence anywhere in the goal -> Not assessed and blank PowerSchool Score.
mastery_goal_grade_model.general_scale_rule: Let n be exact I Can count and t=ceil(n/2). If assessed: I for secure<t; C for secure=t; B for t<secure<n; A for secure=n; A+ for secure=n plus meaningful transfer evidence in the goal.
mastery_goal_grade_model.unit_grade_rule: No overall Unit letter grade is reported or exported. Unit Mastery Goals demonstrated remains a progress count only.
mastery_goal_grade_model.family_not_assessed_meaning: This Mastery Goal has not been checked yet; this is distinct from an attempted check that produced limited or unsuccessful evidence.
mastery_goal_grade_model.in_progress_family_meaning: I means In Progress. It is a current evidence grade, not a permanent label or an averaged penalty; it can change when new or stronger evidence is added.

powerschool.output_rule: Produce one CSV per Mastery Goal per period; no Unit-grade CSV.

evidence_mapping.clean_task_first: Map the clean task before judging the student response.
evidence_mapping.same_source_rule: Repeated prompts for one I Can on the same source are not automatically independent opportunities.

student_practice_link.portfolio_qr_rule: Open Unit only with nothing preselected.
student_practice_link.focus_list_rule: List every current practice-focus I Can as exact code + full statement.

whole_class.rule: Only the highest-leverage genuinely broad shared instructional need supported by current evidence. Show target, affected Practice + check count, recurring evidence pattern, and concise teacher move.

priority_day_groups.eligible_student_rule: Active student has at least one current assessed Mastery Goal grade I and at least one PRACTICE_AND_CHECK I Can.
priority_day_groups.ranking_rule: Sort by number of current assessed MG grades I descending, then PRACTICE_AND_CHECK I Can count descending, then evidence severity (UNUSABLE before LIMITED before PARTIAL), then stable student_key.
priority_day_groups.assignment_rule: Group 1 = ranks 1-15; Group 2 = ranks 16-30; never create Group 3.
priority_day_groups.plan_rule: Exact shared I Can bundle matching is not required. Summarize dominant overlapping needs and recurring evidence patterns, then propose the best common 20-minute Crewtime intervention plus short alternate practice only for a few outlier targets.

pull_in_students.eligible_student_rule: Exactly 1-2 current PRACTICE_AND_CHECK I Can gaps.
pull_in_students.page_rule: Student-centered one-page landscape grid. State Practice + check soon once in the banner; show name/period and exact target(s); no repeated PLAN label.
pull_in_students.overlap_rule: Priority Day and Pull In are scheduling views and may overlap.

intervention_routing.ready_for_recheck: Keep out of intervention seats/lists when the only next step is another independent demonstration.

report_fidelity.human_learning_label_rule: Always show code + full exact I Can statement.
report_fidelity.teacher_report_rule: Normal teacher report is Class Overview; Whole Class when active; one Priority Day Groups page; one Pull In Students page. No normal detailed-evidence appendix.

states.label: Needs first check
states.rule: This I Can has not been checked yet; do not use this label for an attempted check with limited or unsuccessful evidence.

teacher_summary.normal_pages: Class Overview; Whole Class when active; one Priority Day Groups page; one Pull In Students page.
teacher_summary.whole_class: At most one highest-leverage target with evidence-pattern summary and Teacher move.
teacher_summary.priority_day_groups: Maximum two groups of fifteen. Rank by number of current I grades first, then practice-gap count and evidence severity. Exact shared I Can bundles are not required. Each group gets one evidence-backed 20-minute Crewtime plan.
teacher_summary.pull_in_students: Exactly 1-2 PRACTICE_AND_CHECK gaps, student-centered, all current Pull In students on one page, global Practice + check soon banner, no repeated PLAN line.
teacher_summary.appendix: No normal detailed evidence appendix; detailed longitudinal evidence remains in private Portfolio data.

private_results_archive.rule: Every report refresh persists the exact returned results ZIP as a dated archive and as the current Latest copy.

student_support_contacts.matching_rule: Match course roster to support routing by durable student_id. Allow multiple active staff rows per student.
student_support_contacts.role_rule: Course-agnostic free text. Common examples: Case Manager, Special Education Teacher, Study Skills Teacher, Academic Support Teacher, Resource Room Teacher.
student_support_contacts.support_class_rule: Optional free text for any support/resource/study-skills class; blank for relationships not tied to a class.
student_support_contacts.email_rule: Only active rows with a valid supplied staff_email are eligible recipients. Never infer an address from staff name.
student_support_contacts.privacy_rule: Keep routing separate from accommodations and do not store disability/diagnosis narrative in the routing file.

email_report_identity.rule: Email/report delivery must verify stable student identity against the current roster and visible report identity. Filename/key alone is insufficient; any mismatch blocks sending.
